Name: Mina - A Custom NPC
Author: Grunttanamo
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/95ywdSx.png[/img][/center]
[center][b]Mews~! Hi! I'm Mina![/b][/center]
[center]Mina is a fully romanceable custom NPC made for [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b].[/center]
[center]She's a 22-year-old human/fox hybrid with very real fox ears — but no tail! That's intentional and part of who she is. ♥[/center]
[center]Originally from the distant [b]Forgotten Valley [color=#1e84cc][size=1](Yes i also love Story of Seasons~♥)[/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3].[/size][/color][/b]
Mina spent a long time traveling before eventually finding her way to Pelican Town.[/center]
[center]Looking for somewhere safe to stay, she took shelter inside the abandoned Community Center... and that's where her new life begins.[/center]
[center]Mina is playful, affectionate, sometimes a little cheeky and maybe just a [i]tiny[/i] bit clingy. She loves animals, nature, books, cozy places and — more than anything else — [b]Spirit's Eve[/b].[/center]
[center]As you get closer to her, you'll slowly learn more about her past, the reason she has such a hard time letting people get close... and why she has an even harder time letting them go once she trusts them.[/center]
[center][b]Mews~[/b][/center]
[line]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Odl68zi.png[/img][/center]
[center]Mina is designed to grow alongside your save and gradually become part of Pelican Town rather than simply standing around waiting for the player.

[/center]
[center][b][size=4]Her main features include:[/size][/b]

❤️ [b]Fully romanceable and marriageable[/b], with a complete relationship storyline from 2 to 14 hearts.
💬 [b]A large amount of dialogue[/b] covering seasons, years, weather, dating, marriage, children, festivals, progression and more.
🏘️ [b]World integration[/b], with friendships and interactions involving both Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded characters.
🍇 [b]Stardew Valley Expanded integration[/b], including characters, locations, progression and events.
🎃 [b]Festival participation[/b], including special outfits and multiple rotating Spirit's Eve cosplays.
🌸 [b]A unique Flower Dance experience[/b], with her own Flower Dance outfit and dedicated dance sprites.
👗 [b]Seasonal portraits and sprites[/b], giving Mina different appearances throughout the year.
🎁 [b]Custom quests, gifts and mail[/b], including additional friendship and story content.
🎬 [b]Movie Theater reactions and preferences.
[/b]🏝️ [b]Ginger Island and late-game dialogue.
[/b]💍 [b]Expanded married life[/b], including routines, social visits, spouse content and family dialogue.
👶 [b]Pregnancy, adoption and child-related dialogue.
[/b]🏢 [b]Support for both Community Center and Joja progression[/b].
🌎 [b]Additional dialogue[/b] [b]and character development beyond Year 1.[/b][/center]
[center]
And there are a few smaller surprises scattered throughout the mod too. ♥[/center]

[spoiler][b][size=4]Version 0.31.5 — Event Location Fixes[/size][/b]

[b]Mews~! 🦊💙[/b]
This update adds automatic Ridgeside Village compatibility for Mina’s festival locations.
Ridgeside Village expands several vanilla festival maps, which caused Mina to appear in incorrect or unreachable locations when using the standard coordinates.

Mina will now automatically detect whether Ridgeside Village is installed and use the appropriate festival positions for:
[b]
Flower Dance[/b]
[b]Dance of the Moonlight Jellies [/b]
[b]Stardew Valley Fair [/b]
[b]Feast of the Winter Star
[/b]
[b]Players without Ridgeside Village will continue using the recently verified standard SVE positions. ♥[/b]
No configuration is required — Mina handles the map switch automatically. Fufu~ [b]🦊💙

[/b][b][u]Added[/u][/b] Turkish Translation made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Lixutenant]Lixutenant[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/bouffonj]bouffonj[/url]
[b][u] Added[/u][/b] Simplified Chinese Translation made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/WeedyYe]WeedyYe[/url]

[b][size=4]Version 0.31.0 — Existing Save Compatibility Update[/size][/b]

This update mainly improves compatibility for players [color=#1e84cc][b][u]who install Mina on an already progressed save[/u].[/b][/color] ♥

[b][u]Added[/u][/b] a separate introduction events for saves where the Community Center has already been restored.
[b][u]Added[/u][/b] a separate introduction for completed Joja-route saves.
[b][u]Added[/u][/b] Joja-compatible alternatives for events that originally relied on the Community Center or Junimos.
[b][u]Added[/u][/b] appropriate dialogue and event adjustments for progressed saves.
[b][u]Improved[/u][/b] Mina's living situation and story continuity depending on the chosen route.
[b][u]Added[/u][/b] several small event, camera and progression fixes.
[b][u]Added[/u][/b] two new past/memory events involving Mina and her mother. 🦊♥
[b]Added[/b] Spanish Translation made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rupnan]Rupnan[/url]
(A huge thank you to Rupnan for creating Mina's Spanish translation! ♥ Thanks to you, even more players can now meet this little fox and enjoy her story. Mews~! ♥)

You should no longer need to start a new save just to properly experience Mina's story. Mews~![/spoiler]
